title: Columba livia - Rock Dove XC539061
author: Marie-Lan Taÿ Pamart
changes: Feral rock pigeon (Columba livia) in Paris giving three soft coos while waiting for seeds, a recording shared through Xeno-canto (XC539061). Trimmed to 14.40–17.10 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
